title: aztec-whistle-lbm: 3D lattice Boltzmann simulation of an Aztec skull whistle
description: Three-dimensional lattice Boltzmann large-eddy simulation (D3Q19, regularized BGK, Smagorinsky model) of the airflow and sound of a 3D-printable Aztec skull-whistle replica, with grid-convergence, blowing-pressure and sound-quality analyses, SLURM job scripts, the figures and tables of the accompanying paper, and recordings of a 3D-printed model. The raw simulation output, the simulated sound and the explainer video are archived in a separate Zenodo dataset.
